---
applyTo: "src/**/*.md"
description: "Enforce concise, testable, and traceable planning documentation quality across all project docs."
---

# Documentation Quality Instructions

When editing planning documents under `src/`:

- Keep sections scannable with short paragraphs and clear headings.
- Prefer explicit, testable statements over broad intent language.
- Preserve requirement traceability when scope changes.
- Distinguish clearly between:
  - facts
  - assumptions
  - open questions
- End substantial updates with explicit next actions.

Consistency rules:

- Do not mix conflicting numbers across related docs (targets, counts, milestones).
- Keep naming consistent for personas, goals, and milestones.
- If a requirement is removed, update linked tasks and risks in the same change.
